## Complete current AgentWorks maintenance train

AgentWorks BOM 1.18.0 assembles the complete current, certified maintenance train. It advances
Hooks to 0.8.2, Journal to 1.8.2, Workflow to 0.12.1, Experiment to 0.7.1, Memory to 0.5.1,
ACP Java SDK to 0.16.1, Claude Agent SDK to 1.5.1, Bench to 0.6.1, Judge to 0.15.1, Sandbox to
0.10.2, and Client to 0.29.3.

The managed set now covers all 72 discovered consumer-facing AgentWorks coordinates. This adds the
previously omitted Client integrations, provider SDKs and starters; Journal capture integrations;
Judge integrations; and the Experiment Workflow adapter. Each added coordinate is a published
consumer module rather than a count-based or static-list assumption.

Compatible-line dependency maintenance advances Jackson 2 to 2.22.2, Jackson 3 to 3.2.2, Reactor
to 3.8.7, Spring AI to 2.0.1, Mockito to 5.23.0, Byte Buddy to 1.18.12, and JUnit 5 to 5.14.4.
JUnit 6 remains deferred. JSpecify is managed at 1.0.1 to converge the actual combined Maven
consumer graph exercised by the BOM verification suite.
